**[[2024 Shangla bombing]]

**[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
***The [[Israeli Air Force]] bombs [[Deir ez-Zor Governorate]], [[Syria]], killing an [[Iran]]ian [[Quds Force]] officer and 15 other militants. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-airstrikes-deir-elzour-iran-israel-b386b4c4a1d5f55d9fc5a96015b99a53 (AP)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Israel]]i warplanes launch [[airstrike]]s against [[Hezbollah]] targets near the towns of [[Ras Baalbek]] and [[Hermel]] in [[Baalbek-Hermel Governorate]], [[Lebanon]], killing at least three Hezbollah members. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/suspected-israeli-airstrikes-hit-northeast-lebanon-say-four-security-sources-2024-03-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse]]
**The [[Francis Scott Key Bridge (Baltimore)|Francis Scott Key Bridge]] in [[Baltimore]], [[Maryland]], [[United States]], collapses after the container ship {{MV|Dali||2}} strikes a bridge column, causing multiple vehicles to fall into the water below. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/francis-scott-key-bridge-baltimore-collapse-container-ship/ (CBS News)]
**[[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] says that the [[Government of the United States|federal government]] will pay for the full cost of rebuilding the bridge. [https://www.wmar2news.com/local/president-biden-says-federal-government-will-pay-full-cost-to-replace-the-bridge (WMAR-TV)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**The [[Supreme Court of the United States|US Supreme Court]] announces that it will hear oral arguments on whether to restrict access to [[mifepristone]], a commonly-used [[abortion pill]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-68657692 (BBC News)]
*The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[High Court of Justice]] grants [[WikiLeaks]] founder [[Julian Assange]] a stay of [[extradition]] to the [[United States]], and demands that the US not consider the [[death penalty]] against Assange if he is sent to the US to face [[espionage]] [[criminal charge|charges]]. [https://apnews.com/article/britain-wikileaks-julian-assange-espionage-appeal-98c15267f0cdf63685bfb49766749a0a (AP)]
*Former [[Kyrgyzstan]] deputy [[Raimbek Matraimov]] is detained in [[Baku]], [[Azerbaijan]], and is extradited to Kyrgyzstan. [https://akipress.com/news:765829:Former_Deputy_Chairman_of_State_Customs_Service_of_Kyrgyzstan_extradited_to_Bishkek_from_Baku/ (AKIPress)]
